s.note: the Grandmaster's colourful palace on Sakaar
s.how: Cut a quarter watermelon, 2 kiwifruit, a quarter pineapple and a dragonfruit into chunks and thread onto skewers. Drizzle with lime juice, honey and a pinch of chilli. Arrange in a rainbow.

s.note: the gentle rock man with the New Zealand accent
s.how: Mix 500g pork sausage mince with a grated onion and carrot and herbs. Roll in 2 sheets puff pastry, egg wash, sprinkle with sesame and cut into 16. Bake at 200C for 25 minutes. Serve warm with plenty of tomato sauce for dipping.

m.how: Rub a 1.8kg lamb shoulder with 4 garlic cloves, rosemary and lemon. Roast covered at 150C for 5 hours until it pulls apart. Roast 1kg potatoes alongside. Mix 200g Greek yoghurt with chopped mint to serve.

w.how: Beat 200g butter with 100g sugar, add 180g flour, 2 tbsp cocoa and 50g cornflakes. Bake 16 mounds at 180C for 14 minutes. Ice with 150g icing sugar mixed with 1 tbsp cocoa and water, and top each with half a walnut.

d.note: the beer Doctor Strange gives Thor that keeps refilling
d.how: Chill 3L of lager and keep a big jug of it on the table with ice packs around it. Top every mug up the moment it gets low, all night long. Another!
